hooks.command: jq -r ".tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path" | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py|*.pyi) uv run ruff check --fix --quiet "$f"; uv run ruff format --quiet "$f";; *.md) uv run rumdl check --fix --quiet "$f";; esac; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */.agents/wio/config.toml) out=$(uv run wio config check 2>/dev/null); [ $? -ne 1 ] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */.agents/wio/templates/*.md) out=$(uv run wio templates check 2>/dev/null); [ $? -ne 1 ] || { printf '%s\n' "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; }
